seoDescription: How Umbra compares to DevToys on price, platforms, tools, source, and privacy verification. Checked 2026-09-19.
intro: DevToys is the closest free, open-source comparison to Umbra. Here's how the two compare, checked 2026-09-19.

rows.label: Privacy verification
rows.umbra: A documented, repeatable network-monitor check you can run yourself
rows.competitor: States "privacy-focused"; no published verification mechanism found as of 2026-09-19

verdict: DevToys has more tools today and is genuinely open source — you can read, modify, and redistribute the code under its licence, which Umbra's source-available status doesn't grant. Where the two differ is verification: DevToys states it's privacy-focused; Umbra publishes a specific, repeatable check — a network monitor, run yourself, described on the home page — that shows what actually happens, tool by tool. Umbra also ships a local AI feature, offline text recognition, that DevToys doesn't have as of this writing.
